overall_summary: The channel has a very small sample size with overall low view counts (max 41 views), making statistical confidence low. However, 'self respect' and chat/phone interaction themes (like typing, deleting chats, status lists) show higher baseline engagement compared to pure sad or late-night thoughts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about self-respect involving concrete phone actions (e.g., clearing chat, unpinning, removing from lists) performed relatively better (AfaLxMy6FMY with 41 views, rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views).
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible digital actions related to phone privacy or letting go rather than abstract sadness.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focused purely on late-night thoughts and vague waiting without specific physical micro-actions scored very low (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ with 5 views, WhJ-VwRa3Rg with 7 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night or tea-drinking openers; ground every story in an immediate, recognizable everyday tech or life habit.

next_video.concept: A story about clearing out the cloud backup or shared drive where old photos were automatically synced, representing a final silent clean-up of the past.

next_video.reason: Tests a fresh micro-action angle (cloud storage memories) within the proven self-respect and digital detachment winning pattern while avoiding repetitive chat-unpinning hooks.
